tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ kha 'bar ma'i mdos chen ma mo'i gdon sogs gnod pa kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo mañju gho ṣā ya/ dang por thugs bskyed bar du tshogs bsags mthar/ /mngon sangs rgyas nas theg gsum gdul bya la/ /chos 'khor bskor mdzad thub dbang la btud nas/ /de gsungs kha 'bar ma yi mdos chog bri/ /'di la gnyis/ bca' thabs dang*/ cho ga'i rim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sa stegs sam/ ras shog lta bu yang rung ste/ dbus nas sor bzhis zlum bskor lte ba dang*/ de'i phyir sor bzhis zlum por bskor ba la pad 'dab brgyad/ de'i phyir sor bzhis bskor ba la pad 'dab bcu drug de'i phyir sor bzhis bskor ba la pad 'dab so gnyis/ de'i phyi rol tu grub bzhi sgo bzhi/ nang gi shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus su mañji sogs kyi ster du ston pa'i sku/ nang gi 'dab ma brgyad la sems dpa' brgyad/ bar gyi 'dab ma bcu drug la nyan thos bcu drug dang*/ phyi'i 'dab ma so gnyis la rang rgyal so gnyis kyi tshon spungs rnams dgod/ khyams su phyogs skyong bcu dang sgo bzhir rgyal chen bzhi'i tshon spungs 'god cing*/ de rnams kha dog ljang bsgyur bya/ mdun du dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs dang 'bul gtor/ chu gnyis nyer spyod sogs kyi mchod pa du mas mtha' bskor ba'am ci 'byor bsham zhing yang na gdugs sogs kyi rnam pa'ang bya'o/ /de'i mdun gyi shar ngos su chos 'byung phyi nag la nang dmar ba/ rtse mo phyir bstan pa bris pa'i dbus su lcags thabs sam/ dkar gong gi sgyed bu'i khar zangs gzhong sogs kyi nang du rtsam phye sogs las kha 'bar ma'i gzugs khru gang las mi chung ba mdog mi sdug cing 'jigs su rung ba/ lto ba che ba/ yan lag phra ba/ lag pa gnyis sbar mo gdangs pa/ lung thang gi mig 'gron bu'i so/ zer mo dang bal nag gi skra/ mu tig gi klad pa/ dung gi rus pa/ sha zho sha'i snying bya zhing ma 'dzoms na de'i dod tsam bya/ rkang ba gnyis tshog bu'i tshul gyis re lde'i sgye chung nas chan gyis rgyangs ba'i 'bol la gnas pa/

dpral bar g.yu/ sked par byang mig dgu dang sho dkar nag gi rgyan 'dogs/ de'i phrag pa g.yas par pho shing stag pa la lo grangs kyi khram byas pa 'dzug cing*/ g.yon par mo shing glang ma la gos dar gyi ras ma btags pa 'dzug /lus la gos dang dar tshon sna lngas brgyan/ mdun du yon bdag gam nad pa'i glud rang gi cha byad can dang mthar ngar mi brgya rtsa/ gtor chung brgya rtsa/ sna tshogs pa'i gzugs 'gros brgya rtsa brgyad sogs kyis bskor/ gzhan yang changs bu/ mtheb kyu/ zan ril brgya rtsa brgyad re dang*/ 'o ma'i mchod yon dang*/ nas chan rnams kyang sta gon bya/ bdun du zhabs bsil/ me tog la sogs pa'i nyer spyod lnga rnams dang*/ gzhi bdag gi gtor ma dang cha gsum gyi gtor ma/ brgya rtsa'i zan ril rnams kyang bsham/ glung rdzongs kyi chas 'bru sna/ dar sna/ sman sna/ rin po che sna tshogs sam ci 'grub/ grub na rnams 'joms kyi bum chog dang gtor ma brgya rtsa gtor mkhan logs su bya/ mdun du gtor 'theb lngar rim par nas chan/ 'o ma/ changs bu/ mtheb kyu zan rim rnams bshams la chab bran nas bsngo/ gzhung nas 'byung ba'i bden stobs brjod dang mnyam du gtor ma de rnams zangs gzhong sogs kyi snod du blug cing rol mo'i sgra bya/ yang gtor 'theb rnams chus bshal te gtor rdzas rnams gong ltar bsham nas sngar bzhin brgya dang brgyad bsngo/ de yang nga bzhi'i par kha 'bar ma kha tshur blta ba la mgron gyi tshul du bsngo zhing*/ nga bzhi song ba dang kha phar bsgyur te lag pa gnyis su changs bu re 'jog cing*/ nga lnga man nga bzhis rdzongs kyi tshul du byas nas ster/ phyir skye ba'i dus su rnam 'joms kyi bum chu mthor bas sna drangs/ spos phor gser skyems rol mo sogs dang bcas pa cho ga'i gzhung ltar bya'o/ /gnyis pa cho ga'i rim pa la gnyis/ bdag bskyed dang*/ mdun bskyed do/ /dang po ni/ paṇa chen rin po che'i cho ga sogs las bdag bdun gnyis 'jug pa gcig gis mdzad 'dug kyang*/

blo chung bdag gis de gnyis cig car du blos 'chun dka' bar mthong bas 'dir bdag mdun so sor bya ba'i rim pa ltar bshad par bya ste/ de yang bdag bskyed la gtso rkyang gis chog cing*/ lha drug bskyed kyi dbang du byas na/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi sgom pa sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā was stong bar sbyangs/ de ltar bdag gi de kho na nyid don dam par spros pa thams cad dang bral ba ji ltar yin pa de bzhin du lha'i de kho na nyid kyang de bzhin yin pas/ de gnyis chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa bzhin du rnam par mi rtog pa'i snang ba'i sgo de nyid du bdag dang lha'i de kho na nyid dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ mu ne mu ne ma hā mu na ye swāhā zhes pa'i sngags kyi gdangs kyi rnam pa nam mkha' la grags par gyur/ bdag dang lha'i de kho na nyid dbyer mi phyed pa'i rnam pa can gyi rang gi sems zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du gyur ba'i steng du/ sngags kyi gdangs kyi rnam pa nam mkha' la grags pa de nyid shin tu yongs su dag pa'i dngul chu gser gyi bye ma la zhen pa ltar yig 'bru bris pa'i rnam pa can du 'khod pa yaungs su gyur pa las bdud rtsis gang pa'i lhung bzed gyi steng du oṃ mu ne nas swāhā zhes pas mtshan par byung*/ zla ba phyag mtshan sngags dang bcas pa las 'od zer sna tshogs byung ba'i rtse mo las shākya'i rgyal po'i lha'i gzugs dpag tu med pa byung nas nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad khyab par byas/ rgyal ba thams cad la mchod pa'i sprin chen po sprul pas lags par mchod/ gzhan yang sprin chen po sprul pa las bdud rtsi'i char rgyun babs pas dmyal ba la sogs pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi me rnams zhi zhing de rnams tshim par byas nas/ lha'i sku dang bcas pa'i 'od zer slar log rang gi sems zla ba'i dkyil 'khor phyag 'tshan sngags dang bcas pa la bzhugs pa yongs su gyur pa las/

rang nyid bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgyas bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams pa/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ na bza' chos gos rnam gsum gsol zhing mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ 'od kyi phung po 'phro ba'i dbus na byang chub kyi shing la sku rgyab brten pas seṅge'i khri'i steng du pad+ma dngazla ba'i gdan la zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs dkar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ut+bha wa ye swāhā/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ ma lus sems can zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig gi mthar/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ mchod pa amṛ tas bsangs/ sābhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ nas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can ster ba'i nus pa can du gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ gis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ shākya mu ne ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā'i bar gyis mchod de/ thabs mkhas thugs rje sogs sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ de nas/ oṃ mu ne sogs kyi sngags ci 'grub bzla zhing yig brgya brjod de mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya'o/ 7 /gnyis pa mdun bskyed la gnyis/ 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i mgron bskyed tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ sgrub gzhi amṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was stong bar sbyangs/

stong ba'i ngang las mdun gyi gnas su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma rim pa gsum pa lte ba dang bcas pa/ lte ba'i steng khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de ltar bdag gi de kho na nyid don dam par spros pa thams cad dang bral ba ji ltar yin pa de bzhin du zhes pa nas/ yongs su gyur ba las bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa nas/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ yang na/ stong ba'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bcom ldan 'das zhes sogs byas kyang chog cing*/ gang byed kyang*/ rim pa dang po la mdun nas rim pa bzhin du/ phyag na rdo rje/ spyan ras gzigs/ 'jam dpal/ nam mkha'i snying po/ sa'i snying po/ sgrib sel/ kun bzang*/ byams pa ste nye ba'i sras chen brgyad dang*/ rim pa gnyis pa la rim pa bzhin du rab 'byor/ ko'u de n+ya/ 'od srung chen po/ shā ri'i bu/ mo'u 'gal gyi bu/ ma 'gags ba/ kun dga' bo/ /nye bar 'khor/ ka ta ya na/ ba ku la/ rta thul/ ming chen/ dga' bo/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ gang po/ 'char ga ste nyan thos chen po bcu drug dang*/ rim pa gsum pa la gdung ba sel ba la sogs pa rang rgyal so gnyis/ de'i phyi rol tu phyogs skyong bcu/ sgo bzhir rgyal po chen po bzhi dang bcas par gyur/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po nas/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyi sngags lan drug gam gcig rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rgyal ba shākya thub pa la/ nye ba'i sras chen brgyad dang*/ nyan thos chen po bcu drugarang rgyal chen po so gnyis la sogs pa rgyal sras nyan rang 'phags tshogs thams cad dang*/ phyogs skyong bcu dang rgyal chen bzhi la sogs pa'i 'jig rten skyong ba 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad gnas 'dir spyan drangs/ spos sogs dang bcas/ ma lus sems can sogs tshigs bcad kyi phror/ hūṃ/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i/

/sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /'phags pa nyan thos rang rgyal rnams/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang*/ /rgyal po chen po sde bzhi dang*/ /'jig rten skyong ba rnam pa bcu/ /'khor bcas mchod pa'i gnas 'dir byon/ /lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po dang*/ /nam mkha' lding dang dri za dang*/ /rlung lha dang ni lus srul bo/ /gshin rje dang srin po dang*/ /mkha' 'gro dang ni ro langs dang*/ /lto 'phye che dang grul bum dang*/ /gza' dang rgyu skar mkha' rgyu dang*/ /gdon rigs stong phrag brgyad cu rnams/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' nyan phyir/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir myur du byon/ /bdag gis dga' ston cher bgyid kyi/ /zhi ba'i sems kyis 'khod par gyis/ /e h+ye hi/ dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa so so dang gnyis su med par gyur/ pad+ma ka ma la ye stāṃ/ 'dir cho ga snga ma dag las mgron rnams spyan drangs nas bskyed pa'i dam tshig pa la bstim tshul mi gsal yang*/ bstims na legs par sems te gzhan du na dam tshig pa bskyed pa la dgos pa mi snang bas so/ /spyan drangs nas nam mkhar bzhugs par byed pa'ang mi 'thad de/ dam tshigs bskyed pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas mchod pa sngar byin gyis ma brlabs na 'dir byin brlabs bya ste/ de yang sngar ltar la 'dod yon sogs kyang byin brlab bya'o/ /de nas/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /thub dbang 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ shākya mu ne sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā nas/ shap+ta pra tī ts+tsha dang*/ spar r+sha pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ 'khor lo nor bu btsun mo sogs/ /rgyal srid rin chen sna bdun dang*/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dpal be'u sogs/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad dag kyang 'bul/ / gling bzhi nyi zla ri rab dang*/ /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod sogs/

/ji snyed mchod pa'i tshogs mchis pa/ /kun kyang khyed la dbul bar bgyi/ /spro na/ me tog dam pa zhes pa nas/ byang chub chen por bsngo/ /de nas/ gang tshe rkang gnyis sogs sam/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /zhes sogs ci rigs kyis bstod la/ /thub pa'i snying po ci 'grub bzlas nas yig brgya brjod/ 'das gtor a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma phul du byung ba'i lha rdzas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ mgron rnams kyi ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wa ra i daṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun gyis phul la/ sngags kyi mthar ar+ghaṃ sogs sbyar nas mchod de/ thabs mkhas thugs rje ma dang*/ phyag byar 'os pa zhes sogs kyis bstod/ khyod la mchod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /zhes sogs kyang brjod/ bskang gso byed pa dang 'brel dgos pa'i nges pa med kyang byed na cho ga 'di'i sngon du byas nas gtor 'bul skabs 'dir rung tsam ste/ bskul bzhag nas bstod pa yan rdzogs bar bya'o/ /cha gsum yang gtong*/ gnyis pa 'jig rten pa'i mgron la gsum/ bskyed cing spyan drangs nas mchod pa/ 'phrin las bcol ba/ rdzong ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ oṃ swa bhā was kha 'bar ma'i gzugs stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las preṃ las yi dwags kyi rgyal mo kha la me 'bar ma mdog nag mo/ mi sdug cing 'jigs su rung ba/ kha cher gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ kha rlangs kyis nad dang dal yams sprin ltar 'thibs pa/ mig dmar zhing skra 'dzings pa/ lto ba rdzing bu ltar che zhing yan lag shin tu phra ba/ sbar mo gdangs nas skye 'gro'i srog la rngams pa'i tshul can/

nad bdag rims bdag la sogs pa'i 'byung po bye ba'i 'khor dang bcas par gyur/ spyan 'dren pa ni/ /bh+yo 'di nas byang phyogs pha rol na/ / ri rab chen po'i byang phyogs kyi/ /gling bar mun pa'i 'jig rten na/ /ba tsha tsha sgo'i 'gram phug gi /bgegs kyi rgyal mo gshegs su gsol/ /sngon tshe thub pa'i sbyan sngar dam bcas bzhin/ /dam las ma 'da' mchod gtor 'di rnams ni/ /ji srid grub par bdag gis khyed mchod pas/ /de srid bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /preṃ yaṃ dzaḥ aṅku dzashaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rang gi gzugs dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ pre ta rā dze sa pā ri wa ra puṣ+be nas/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā'i bar gyis mchod/ raṃ las skyes pa'i me 'bar ba'i gur gyi nang du chud par gyur /de nas changs bu sogs aṃ mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor rdzas rnams kha dog dri ro reg bya'i nus pa phun sum tshogs pa rgya nam mkha'i khyon dang mnyam pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ na maḥsarba ta tha ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/ zhes pa bdun nam nyer gcig res bsngo/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku 'byams bzlas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skabs 'dir cho ga snga ma las bden stobs brjod tshul rgyas bsdus gnyis gsungs shing de gnyis gdam kha can du bshad kyang*/ 'dir de gnyis kyi don phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas 'jug pa bde bar brjod bar bya ste/ de yang*/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos gzugs kyi sku gnyis brnyes pa mthar phyin cing*/ stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa'i yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/

sgrib pa thams cad dang bral zhing bsnyengs pa mi mnga' bas bdud dang phas kyi rgol ba thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa'i mthu thogs med pa ldan cing sems can thams cad kyi mgon skyabs dam par gyur ba'i bden pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos ni thog tha bar dge zhing mi mthun phyogs thams cad rab tu 'joms pa'i bden pa dang*/ gzhan yang gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags sogs kyi bden pa dang*/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa 'phags pa nye ba'i sras chen brgyad kyi bden pa dang*/ 'phags pa rab 'byor la sogs pa nyan thos chen po bcu drug gi bden pa dang*/ 'phags pa gdung ba sel ba la sogs pa rang rgyal chen po so gnyis dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi bden pa dang*/ mdor na dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ bdag gi bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i stobs kyis/ bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la gnod pa'i nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu gdon rigs sum brgya drug cu/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga/ rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa dang bkra mi shis pa dang dus ma yin pa 'chi ba la sogs pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar gyur cigakhyad par du yang sbyin bdag gi nad thams cad zhi bar gyur cig zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams thams cad rgyas par gyur cig rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ de ltar brgya rtsa bya zhing*/ bsngo thengs re la bden stobs rgyas pa la ma lcogs na/ thog tha bar gsum la rgyas pa dang*/ gzhan rnams la ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ 'di ltar mchod sbyin bgyis pa'i mthus sbyin pa'i bdag po'i nad gdon bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cigaces sam/ yang na/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs zhes sogs brjod/ skang gso dang 'brel na chos skyong gi bskul ba skabs 'dir bya'o/ /de nas rol mo'i dbyangs dang bcas pas bskul ba ni/

hūṃ nyon cig ma lus bgegs kyi tshogs/ /bdag gis de ring khyod mchod kyis/ / song zhig ma 'dug bgegs kyi tshogs/ /phyin chad 'di ltar ma byed cig /khyod kyi stobs dang rtsal mthong na/ /khyod kyis phan gnod byed par nus/ /khyod ni lha yi sprul pa ste/ /khyod kyis phan gnod mi nus med/ /sngon chad mchod sbyin ma thob pas/ /de ring bdag gis khyod mchod kyis/ /me tog spos dang mar me dang*/ /dri chab zhal zas 'di bsnams la/ /bgegs kyi rgyal mo 'gro bar bgyis/ /sngon chad lan chags yod na yang*/ /mchod sbyin 'di yis bral bar bgyis/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' bcag dang*/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes pa yis/ / gnod par gyur na ma legs kyis/ /bgegs chen khyod ni da song zhig /rdo rje chen po mchog 'dzin pa'i/ /mgon po chen pos byin rlobs la/ /blo ngan gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas myur du spong*/ /spangs pa'i sems can chen po de/ /ji srid 'khor ba'i spyod yul du/ /ngan song gsum du yang dang yang*/ /shin tu mi bzad cho nge 'debs/ /bdag nyid chen po'i sangs rgyas bka'/ /tshig las 'das na rdul bzhin brlag /de bas dam tshig 'da' ma byed/ /de nas rang nyid 'jigs byed dam/ hūṃ mdzad du bsgyur nas/ hūṃ/ mtshon chas mi 'jigs gang yang med/ /'tsho ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzem/ /rang gi lus la dpe long la/ /gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /zhes brjod de rdo rje sogs kyis gzugs brnyan de la tshad tshad bya/ de nas lag tu rdo rje bzung nas/ hūm̐/ dam tshig 'di las 'da' ma byed/ /gal te dam tshig 'das gyur na/ /a dza ka yi dog pa ltar/ /mgo po tshal ba bdun du 'gas/ /zhes brjod de dri chus gnas gsum du thig le bya/ yang rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ de nas yang gzugs de kha phyir bstan nas/ hūṃ/ bgegs kyi tshogs rnams da chos shig /'jig rten gtso mo chos tsam na/ /ri rab chen po ldems se ldems/

/rgya mtsho chen po dkyil li li/ /'gro drug kun kyang sha ra ra/ dar tshon sna lnga pu ru ru/ /glud bdag chen po chas tsam na/ /'jig rten srung ma thams cad kyang*/ /phyi yi skyel ma nyil li li/ /mun pa'i na bun 'thibs se 'thibs/ /mdos bdag chen mo chas tsam na/ /brjed byed yi dwags dri za'i tshogs/ /gtor len mang po hrugs se hrugs/ /dmag dpon chen mo chas tsam na/ /pi wang gling bu sengs se sengs/ /bdud btsan drag byed 'khor bcas kun/ /glu gar bro brdung chems se chems/ /'byung po 'bum gyi yum gcig mo/ /yi dwags bye ba'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di khyer la/ /rang rang gnas su song shing*/ / sngon tshe shākya thub pa yi/ /spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bka' ma bcag /dam pa'i bden tshig bsun ma 'byin/ /yon bdag rgyu sbyor chud ma son/ /rten 'brel tshogs pa'i thabs ma bslu/ gal te bka' las 'das gyur na/ /snying la nad gso me bzhin 'bar/ /mgo lus dum bu stong du 'gro/ /de nas dam tshig thub par srungs/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi bka' ma bcag /rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po la/ /bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol/ /bsdams pa glod la mnan pa theg /gnod pa thams cad myur du sol/ /gal te de ltar mi byed na/ /gtor ma 'di ni gnyen po yin/ /nad dang mtshon gyis brlag par byed/ /de nas phyi rol tu skyel sar slebs pa na gser skyems mchod cing*/ gzugs de kha bug gam kha phyir bstan nas bzhag la/ hūṃ skyur ro rgya mtsho'i gting du bskyur/ mnan no ri rab 'og tu mnan/ /'di nas dpag tshad lnga brgya na/ /gshin rje'i rgyal po chos 'chad kyi/ de yi drung du chos nyon cig /byang chub sems ni ma skyes par/ /steng gi phyogs su ma 'byung zhig /nam zhig byang chub sems skyes na/ /dkon mchog gsum po bsten mdzod dang*/ /thugs rje chen pos gzung bar 'gyur/

/ces brjod cing kha bug tu bzhag la/ bzlog pa bya/ 'ga' zhig ni gong du bshad zin to/ /de nas nang du 'ongs te lha la mchod pa sngar bzhin rgyas bsdus ci rigs kyis phul nas bstod pa bya/ yig brgya brjod cing*/ ma rnyed ces sogs bzod gsol rgyas bsdus gang rung dang*/ gtso bo la 'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tu/ /zhes sogs kyis brtan bzhugs dang*/ 'khor rnams la ni/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /zhes sogs kyi 'jug tu/ mgron gzhan rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ ces brjod de bkra shis bya'o/ /snyigs dus ma rungs skye bo rnams/ /rku 'phrog srog gcod la sogs pa/ /ngan song du ma la zhugs pas/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro khros shing 'khrugs/ /de tshe nad yams dal yams kyi/ /gnod pa rang gzhan du ma la/ /char ltar babs te mi 'dod pa'i/ /sdug bsngal sna tshogs ster bar byed/ /de phyir ston pas chos tshul 'di/ /gnod pa kun dang ma mo yi/ /gdon kun bzlog phyir gsungs pas na/ /cho ga 'di nyid bstan par rigs/ /'dir 'bad dge ba kun+da'i gnyen/ /gang zhig thob des 'gro ba kun/ /nad gdon sdug bsngal mun stugs las/ /rgyal nas phan bde'i lam gsal shog /ces kha 'bar ma'i mdos kyi rim pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul 'di ni/ shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis dam pa snga ma dag gi phyag srol la cung zad re kha bskang ba'i sgo nas gzhan re gnyis la phan thogs srid snyam nas co ne'i dgon nyid du sbyar ba ste/ par gyi yi ge pa ni tā li la lung gi blo bzang don grub bo/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/kha 'bar ma'i mdos chen ma mo'i gdon sogs gnod pa kun sel bzhugs/ -PAGE 170--PAGE 171--PAGE 158-
